parsed.answer: No, Saturdays do not count as business days. Under Northwind Parcel's policy, business days are Monday to Friday, excluding national holidays. Saturdays and Sundays are not counted when we calculate delivery times. Standard delivery takes 3–5 business days and Express takes 1–2 business days. Delivery windows run from 8:00 to 20:00 local time.
